description.zh: 按阅读阶段整理文献：标题、作者、期刊或会议、年份、来源地址、自己的理解与问题。列表可按待读、在读与已理解筛选，也能搜索、归档与移入回收站；详情直接编辑并在输入时自动存草稿，保存失败保留输入，修订冲突可以载入最新记录。
description.en: Papers organised by reading stage: title, authors, venue, year, source link, your own understanding and questions. The list filters by to read, reading and understood, also searches, archives and trashes; the detail edits in place, keeps a draft while you type, keeps your input when saving fails, and offers the latest record on a revision conflict.

search.zh: 搜索标题、作者、理解与问题
search.en: Search titles, authors, notes and questions

emptyActive.zh: 还没有文献；点「新建」，或在文献追踪卡里把订阅条目加入工作台。
emptyActive.en: No papers yet; use New, or add a feed entry from the paper feed card.

emptyTrash.zh: 回收站是空的。移入回收站的记录三十天后自动清除。
emptyTrash.en: The trash is empty. Trashed records are cleared after thirty days.

emptyStage.zh: 这个阅读阶段还没有文献。
emptyStage.en: No papers in this reading stage.

truncated.zh: 只列出最近 {n} 条，共 {total} 条；用搜索找更早的记录。
truncated.en: Showing the latest {n} of {total}; search for older records.

quotaWarning.zh: 记录已用到 {percent}%，先整理归档或回收站。
quotaWarning.en: Records use {percent}% of the limit; tidy the archive or trash.

materialInvalid.zh: 材料地址只收 http/https 的完整地址，说明不能为空。
materialInvalid.en: Material links must be complete http/https addresses with a title.

yearInvalid.zh: 年份要是 1000 到 3000 之间的整数。
yearInvalid.en: The year must be an integer between 1000 and 3000.

sourceUrlInvalid.zh: 来源地址只收 http/https 的完整地址。
sourceUrlInvalid.en: The source link must be a complete http/https address.

understandingHint.zh: 订阅摘要不代表已经读懂；写下你自己的理解与问题。
understandingHint.en: A feed abstract does not mean the paper is understood; write your own notes and questions.

draftRestored.zh: 已恢复上次未保存的内容。

unsavedClose.zh: 还有没保存的修改；关闭后草稿会保留。
unsavedClose.en: There are unsaved changes; closing keeps the draft.

conflict.zh: 这条记录在别处更新过，保存被拒绝。可以载入最新的内容，或继续用你的编辑。
conflict.en: This record changed elsewhere and the save was rejected. Load the latest content, or continue with your edits.

loadLatest.zh: 载入最新（放弃本地修改）

trashRestoreHint.zh: 回收站里的记录三十天后自动清除；先恢复再编辑。
trashRestoreHint.en: Trashed records are cleared after thirty days; restore before editing.
